prompt:
Production concept for The Beginning Online, a classic hand-painted isometric MMORPG. Painterly watercolor and gouache texture with crisp readable silhouette, warm neutral rim light from upper left, subdued natural materials, richly painted but uncluttered. Elevated isometric three-quarter camera, showing the front and its right side. Entire single creature visible, centered, generous margin on all sides. NO text, no labels, no UI, no scenery, no floor plane, no cast shadow. Transparent background. One character only. Maintain the specified anatomy.

A tiny adorable sentient tea mushroom, rounded warm ivory body, two short feet, enormous soft sage-green leaf cap shaped like an umbrella, two black bead eyes and a shy smile, one amber dew bead, no weapons. Clearly a mushroom creature, not a jelly.
